deals.title: Kino Lorber Fall Haul
deals.detail: Over 900 titles from $4.99, with 4Ks like 3 Days of the Condor at $17.99 (list $39.95). Blu-ray Forum reports the sale was extended to Oct 27 at noon ET.

deals.title: 31 Days of Syntober
deals.detail: A new featured film each day at 50% off list with 3x reward points, posted at 12:01 pm ET (Oct 25's pick was The Cellar, from $17.49), plus a bundle with Night of the Vamp-Friars for an extra $5 off.

deals.title: Arrow Video Shocktober (UK store)
deals.detail: Up to 50% off hundreds of 4K UHDs, Blu-rays and limited editions on Arrow's UK store, per HotUKDeals; check the US store for its own pricing.

deals.title: Blu-ray.com 4K bargains
deals.detail: Recently listed at Amazon: Akira 4K $11.99 (60% off), Mars Attacks! 4K $14.99 and Jaws 50th Anniversary 4K $14.99 (both half off). Prices move daily.

deals.title: Us / Get Out 4K double feature
deals.detail: $14.99 for both Jordan Peele films on 4K, also matched at Gruv (reported Oct 23).

deals.title: The Mummy Trilogy 4K
deals.detail: All three Brendan Fraser-era Mummy films on 4K UHD for $19.99 (reported Oct 23).

deals.title: Interstellar 4K
deals.detail: $14.96, about $5 below the next best price when posted (reported Oct 20).

deals.title: Hellboy 4K
deals.detail: $15.39 with free shipping, though Amazon lists it as shipping in 1 to 2 months (reported Oct 25).

upcoming.title: Vinegar Syndrome Black Friday
upcoming.detail: Flash pre-order event reported for Nov 1 at 12:01 a.m. ET through Nov 4, with the main Black Friday sale starting Nov 27 at 12:01 a.m. ET.
